rows.resource: Cell WAN uplink (metadata, compressed), 2,500-camera cell
rows.formula: 2,500 x 3,000/h x 154.2 B x 8 + plates 2,500x0.2x3,000/3600x0.5x160 B x8 + health 250/s x 500 B x8; capacity = 50 Mbps minus 30 Mbps viewing budget
rows.design_choice: batch-compressed metadata lane; viewing budget admission-controlled; video never on WAN

rows.resource: Cell WAN uplink, same demand, HLD 20 Mbps link, no viewing
rows.formula: as above against HLD §20.4 primary link
rows.design_choice: HLD link is enough for compressed metadata alone

rows.resource: Cell WAN uplink, raw (uncompressed) metadata, HLD 20 Mbps link
rows.formula: 2,500 x 3,000/h x 1,331.7 B x 8 + real-time lanes
rows.design_choice: WOULD BIND (<1x): compression is mandatory, not an optimisation

rows.resource: District uplink, 5,000-camera district (2 cells, one 100 Mbps link, 60 Mbps viewing budget)
rows.formula: 5,000 x 3,000/h x 154.2 B x 8 + 2 x real-time lanes
rows.design_choice: cell split at 2,500; link scaled per cell

rows.resource: Catch-up after 24 h WAN outage, 5,000-camera district: drain time vs outage
rows.formula: backlog = rate x 24 h x 154.2 B; drain = backlog / (100 Mbps - live rate), viewing paused during catch-up
rows.design_choice: priority lanes: alerts, plates, health first; bulk last; dedup_key makes replay idempotent

rows.resource: Site uplink (camera site -> cell), by design rule
rows.formula: pull to cell only if n_site x 1.0 Mbps x 1.5 <= site uplink; otherwise an edge box analyses on site
rows.design_choice: placement rule converts any would-be link bottleneck into edge compute

rows.resource: Cell ingest LAN (2,500 analysed cameras: sub-streams, main streams on ANPR-grade)
rows.formula: 2,000 x 1.0 Mbps sub-stream + 500 ANPR-grade x 2.0 Mbps main stream
rows.design_choice: sub-stream for T0/T1; main stream only on ANPR-grade cameras

rows.resource: Cell event bus (NATS JetStream R3)
rows.formula: 2,083 obs/s + 208 plates/s + 250 health/s
rows.design_choice: one JetStream cluster per cell; subjects obs.<cell>.<camera>

rows.resource: State event bus (Kafka), real-time lanes only
rows.formula: plates 6,667/s x 160 B + health 8,000/s x 500 B + alert storm 333/s x 2 KB; capacity = 6 x 50 / RF 3
rows.design_choice: bulk observations bypass Kafka as compressed micro-batches to object storage

rows.resource: State event bus IF all observations went through it raw
rows.design_choice: rejected alternative: 1.1x headroom is not a design

rows.resource: State bus partitions: plate topic
rows.formula: 6,667 plates/s / 128 partitions; capacity ASSUMED 5,000 msg/s per partition
rows.design_choice: key = OCR-folded plate

rows.resource: Cell DB write rate (PostgreSQL primary)
rows.formula: 2,500 x 3,000/h; capacity = measured single-stream copy 14,187 rows/s
rows.design_choice: batched COPY per 1 s; partitioned by day

rows.resource: State plate-index write rate (4 hash shards)
rows.design_choice: shard by folded plate = same key as Kafka partition

rows.resource: State plate-index catch-up after 24 h state outage: drain hours
rows.design_choice: cells keep working meanwhile

rows.resource: Cell hot store, 30 days (NVMe per copy)
rows.formula: 2,083 obs/s x 30 d x 2,663 B; capacity 32 TB NVMe per copy
rows.design_choice: time-partitioned; detach to lake after 30 d

rows.resource: State object store, 3 years of compressed observations
rows.formula: 66,667 obs/s x 3 y x 154.2 B; capacity 1.5 PB usable (erasure-coded)
rows.design_choice: grows per year retained, not per camera-second

rows.resource: Object store request rate (micro-batches + alert-storm evidence stills)
rows.formula: 40 cells x 1 batch/min + 333 stills/s
rows.design_choice: micro-batches of >=1 minute keep object count low

rows.resource: Media gateway sessions per cell (cameras being viewed)
rows.formula: 200 viewed cameras; capacity 3 gateway nodes x 150 copy sessions (ASSUMED)
rows.design_choice: one upstream session per camera shared by AI and all viewers (live/hub.py:1-12); gateway sessions set by viewers, not by analysed cameras

rows.resource: Remote viewing (state + investigators)
rows.formula: 1,000 preview tiles x 0.5 Mbps + 100 full tiles x 1.5 Mbps (bitrates: phase16_bridge_profile.json settings)
rows.design_choice: independent of analysed cameras; set by people watching

rows.resource: TURN relay (remote/mobile only)
rows.formula: 200 relayed tiles x 0.5 Mbps; capacity 6 regions x 2 coturn x 0.5 Gbps usable
rows.design_choice: police LAN clients connect direct

rows.resource: API request rate (all users at the state API, pessimistic)
rows.formula: 5,000 users x 1 req/s; capacity 8 servers x 16 workers x (1000/10.38 ms)
rows.design_choice: stateless; district users served by their cell API; heavy aggregates served from rollups

rows.resource: Search: plate lookup fan-out
rows.formula: plate -> one hash shard; no scatter
rows.design_choice: key choice removes fan-out

rows.resource: Search: attribute search scatter-gather
rows.formula: one query hits 40 cells; each cell admits 8 concurrent searches (api/deps.py:100)
rows.design_choice: bounded by time window and 2,000-row cap

rows.resource: Spatial viewport query (PostGIS, 80k cameras)
rows.formula: measured 1.3 ms at 80,000 cameras
rows.design_choice: camera count is fixed by the estate, not by analysis

rows.resource: Watchlist bootstrap of one cell + its 25 edge boxes, seconds over 20 Mbps
rows.formula: 1,000,000 entries x 16 B (two 8-byte keyed hashes) x 26 nodes / 20 Mbps; deltas thereafter ~320 KB/day
rows.design_choice: hashed, delta-versioned bundles; O(1) match per read regardless of list size

rows.resource: Alert storm: alert rows written at the state
rows.formula: 6,667 plates/s x 5% match
rows.design_choice: incident grouping (watchlist/incidents.py) and per-district notification token buckets; the human queue is rate-limited on purpose

rows.resource: Busy highway camera: metadata off its site
rows.design_choice: compute for this camera scales (5 fps ANPR); its metadata does not matter

rows.resource: Health telemetry (metrics series at state)
rows.formula: per-camera series stay in cell Prometheus; state keeps ~1,000 series x 20 per cell
rows.design_choice: cell Prometheus + Thanos, downsampled

rows.resource: Control plane: nodes per cell cluster
rows.formula: ~21 GPU + 10 decode + 10 other + edge boxes on their own fleet
rows.design_choice: one cluster per cell; no statewide cluster

rows.resource: Image/model rollout per cell (25 edge boxes x 2 GB) over 20 Mbps spare
rows.formula: 25 x 2 GB x 8 / 20 Mbps
rows.design_choice: regional OCI mirror; staged rings over >= 3 days
